repos_data.description: Voice dictation menu-bar app for macOS. Press a hotkey, speak, transcript appears at the cursor. Whisper runs locally via WhisperKit on Apple Silicon — no audio, text, or telemetry leaves your Mac. MIT, Swift.
Fast, private push-to-talk dictation for Apple Silicon Macs — local Parakeet TDT v3, no cloud or telemetry.
Voice-to-text dictation app with local (Nvidia Parakeet/Whisper) and cloud models (BYOK). Privacy-first and available cross-platform.
Native local-first macOS speech-to-text, live captions, subtitle editing, offline translation, and on-device Gemma 4 transcript enhancement.
A local LLM workhorse that keeps a memory of your workday. On-device meeting notes, dictation, autocomplete, and recall for macOS. GPLv3.
Mac-native dictation that just works – lives in the notch, zero setup, free forever
Hold Fn key, speak, paste transcribed text. macOS menu bar app.
Local speech-to-text for macOS  on-device AI, fully private, optional cloud
The macOS screen recorder for the rest of us - always free and open source with a native look and feel  📺

🎙️ An intelligent voice productivity assistant that turns speech into clean text, useful actions, and structured knowledge. It helps users capture ideas, communicate naturally, automate repetitive tasks, and stay productive across different apps and workflows.
Private, native macOS app to capture pages, text, notes, links, and images—and find them instantly with full-text search and OCR. Open source; no account or telemetry.
Talk to your Mac — a native macOS voice assistant that sees your screen, drives your Mac, and answers back. Powered by the OpenAI Realtime API. Open source.
